patterns: ^正在查看作者「(.+)」的主题，每次展示 5 个。$
Showing themes by “$1”, 5 at a time.
^确认永久删除账号 (.*)？账号无法恢复，绑定的作者许可会一并删除，已发布主题仍保留。$
Permanently delete account $1? This cannot be undone. The bound author license will also be removed; published themes will remain.
^撤销作者 (.*) 的自动审批许可？$
Revoke the automatic publishing license for author $1?
^删除作者许可 (.*)？已发布主题会保留，但许可记录会被永久移除。$
Delete the author license for $1? Published themes will remain, but the license record will be permanently removed.
^自动主题 ID 获取失败：(.*)$
Failed to get automatic theme ID: {{t:$1}}
Failed to configure the storage directory (HTTP $1)
^管理员账号已创建，但存储目录未应用：(.*)。请进入控制台后在「存储」页面修改。$
Administrator account created, but the storage directory was not applied: {{t:$1}}. Change it on the Storage page in the console.
^删除来源 (.*)？已导入的主题不受影响。$
Delete source $1? Imported themes are not affected.
Local path is not a directory: $1
AList did not return a download URL: $1
You can add at most $1 sources
^留言会在 ([0-9]+) 天后自动删除$
^当前保留 ([0-9]+) 天，到期留言会在后台自动清理。$
Keeping comments for $1 days; expired comments are cleaned up in the background.
Saved: comments are deleted after $1 days
